---
title: "Architecture"
---

IrisPipe is a **Spring Boot 3 + Spring Batch 5** monolith backed by an embedded H2 database.
The frontend is a React 19 SPA communicating over REST and Server-Sent Events.
The entire stack runs locally — no cloud, no agent, no daemon.

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime | Java 21, Spring Boot 3 | Embedded Tomcat |
| Batch engine | Spring Batch 5 | Job/Step/Chunk execution |
| Persistence | H2 (file-mode), JPA/Hibernate | Flyway migrations |
| Observability | Micrometer + Prometheus endpoint | Lifecycle-driven metrics |
| Frontend | React 19, React Router v7 | Vite, TailwindCSS, DaisyUI |
| Real-time | Server-Sent Events (SSE) | `/api/v1/events/runs` |
| Integration tests | k6 | 10 suites, black-box regression |

---

## Layered Architecture

```{mermaid}
graph TB
  subgraph "API Layer"
    ctrl["api/\nREST Controllers\nRequest binding + validation only"]
  end

  subgraph "Core Layer"
    facade["core/service/\nExecution & Query Facades\nApplication boundary"]
    factory["core/factory/\nJob & Step Assembly\nBuilds Batch jobs from snapshot"]
  end

  subgraph "Infrastructure Layer"
    svc["infrastructure/service/\nNarrow Collaborators\n(config / folder / runtime / workspace)"]
    repo["infrastructure/repo/\nJPA Repositories"]
    entity["infrastructure/entity/\nJPA Entities\n(config domain / runtime domain)"]
  end

  subgraph "Cross-cutting"
    obs["observability/\nMetrics Publisher"]
    model["model/ + model/dto/\nDomain Records & API DTOs"]
  end

  ctrl --> facade
  facade --> factory
  facade --> svc
  svc --> repo
  repo --> entity
  facade --> obs
  ctrl --> model
  svc --> model

  style ctrl fill:#eef2ff,stroke:#6366f1
  style facade fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a
  style factory fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a
  style svc fill:#fff7ed,stroke:#f59e0b
  style repo fill:#fdf2f8,stroke:#a855f7
  style entity fill:#fdf2f8,stroke:#a855f7
```

**Call direction is enforced**: Controllers call facades only. Facades call collaborators. Collaborators call repositories. No layer skips another.

## Package Map

```
irispipe/
├── api/                              REST controllers — binding and validation only
├── batch/                            Spring Batch configuration
│   ├── builders/                     JobBuilder and StepBuilder wiring
│   ├── listeners/                    Job/Step lifecycle listeners
│   ├── tasklets/                     Custom tasklet implementations
│   └── writers/                      Custom item writers
├── core/
│   ├── factory/                      Assembles Batch jobs from snapshot at runtime
│   └── service/                      Application-boundary facades
│       ├── PipelineExecutionService  execute / resume / rerun / stop
│       └── PipelineRunQueryService   summary / history / detail assembly
├── infrastructure/
│   ├── config/                       Spring bean config, mappers
│   ├── context/                      Runtime JDBC context objects
│   ├── entity/
│   │   ├── config/                   Pipeline config JPA entities
│   │   └── runtime/                  Run lineage JPA entities
│   ├── repo/
│   │   ├── config/                   Config JPA repositories
│   │   └── runtime/                  Runtime JPA repositories
│   └── service/
│       ├── config/                   Config command, import, read-model, policy
│       ├── folder/                   Folder tree command, read-model, structure
│       ├── runtime/                  Run lifecycle, snapshot, watermark, metadata
│       └── workspace/                Workspace resolution and provisioning
├── model/                            Domain records, enums, mutable summaries
│   └── dto/                          API DTOs
└── observability/                    Metric publishing, lifecycle events
```

## Facade + Collaborator Pattern

Large mixed-responsibility services are intentionally decomposed into a facade plus narrow collaborators.
Example — the Runtime domain:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  ES["PipelineExecutionService\n(facade)"]:::facade

  ES --> RC["RunCommandService\ncreate rows"]
  ES --> RL["RunLaunchService\nstage barrier"]
  ES --> RCT["RunControlPolicy\nstate guards"]
  ES --> RS["RunSnapshotService\npersist / load"]

  classDef facade fill:#eef2ff,stroke:#6366f1,color:#3730a3
```

The same pattern applies across all three domains:

| Domain | Facade | Collaborators |
|---|---|---|
| Config | `PipelineConfigService` | Command, Import, ReadModel, RequestPolicy |
| Folder | `PipelineFolderService` | Command, ReadModel, Structure |
| Runtime | `PipelineExecutionService` | Command, Launch, ControlPolicy, Snapshot |

## Database Schema

### Config tables

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
  iris_workspace ||--o{ iris_pipeline_folder : owns
  iris_workspace ||--o{ iris_pipeline : owns
  iris_pipeline_folder ||--o{ iris_pipeline : contains
  iris_pipeline ||--o{ iris_pipeline_job : defines
  iris_pipeline_job ||--o{ iris_pipeline_execution : "has steps"
```

### Runtime tables

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
  iris_pipeline_run ||--|| iris_pipeline_run_snapshot : "immutable snapshot"
  iris_pipeline_run ||--o{ iris_pipeline_run_job : "latest projection"
  iris_pipeline_run ||--o{ iris_pipeline_run_execution : "attempt history"
  iris_pipeline_run_execution ||--o{ iris_pipeline_run_execution_job : "per-attempt jobs"
```

> **Two read paths**: `PipelineRun` + `PipelineRunJob` serve cheap summary reads. `PipelineRunExecution` + `PipelineRunExecutionJob` serve the full ordered attempt history.

### Config ownership chain

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  WS["iris_workspace"] --> FL["iris_pipeline_folder"]
  FL --> PL["iris_pipeline"]
  PL --> JB["iris_pipeline_job\n(one row per stage×job)"]
  JB --> EX["iris_pipeline_execution\n(one row per step)"]
  JB --> CN["iris_pipeline_job_connection\n(source / dest refs)"]

  style WS fill:#f8fafc,stroke:#94a3b8
  style EX fill:#fdf2f8,stroke:#a855f7
  style CN fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a
```

- `iris_pipeline_job` carries stage ordering and `atomic_level`
- `iris_pipeline_execution` rows are the ordered steps within a job
- `iris_pipeline_job_connection` links jobs to named `iris_connection` entries (or stores inline credentials)

## Runtime Execution Sequence

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant ExecutionService
  participant LaunchService
  participant Batch as Spring Batch

  Client->>API: POST /sync-pipeline
  API->>ExecutionService: execute(pipelineId)
  ExecutionService->>ExecutionService: read config → create Run + Snapshot
  ExecutionService->>LaunchService: launch(snapshot)

  loop each stage
    LaunchService->>Batch: launch jobs in parallel
    Batch-->>LaunchService: all jobs settled
  end

  LaunchService-->>Client: 200 OK (runId)
```

---

## Listener-Driven State Machine

Runtime status is **never set directly by control code**. It is always projected by the listener chain:

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  SB["Spring Batch\nJobListener / StepListener"]
  CJL["CustomJobListener\nonJobExecution(event)"]
  LCS["PipelineRunLifecycleService\nupdateJobStatus(jobName, status)"]
  EJob["iris_pipeline_run_execution_job\nupdate status + timestamps"]
  RunJob["iris_pipeline_run_job\nupdate latest projection"]
  Run["iris_pipeline_run\nupdate status + timestamps"]
  MP["PipelineMetricsPublisher\npublish(event)"]
  MC["Micrometer\ncounter.increment()\ngauge.set()"]

  SB --> CJL
  CJL --> LCS
  LCS --> EJob
  LCS --> RunJob
  LCS --> Run
  LCS --> MP
  MP --> MC

  style SB fill:#f8fafc,stroke:#94a3b8
  style LCS fill:#eef2ff,stroke:#6366f1
  style MP fill:#f0fdf4,stroke:#16a34a
```

This design keeps sync and async execution paths on the same lifecycle model, and keeps meter code out of controllers and DTOs.

---

## Run Status Lifecycle

Each `iris_pipeline_run` moves through a well-defined set of states. Status is never set directly by control code — it is always projected by the listener chain described above.

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*] --> STARTING : execute / resume / rerun

  STARTING --> STARTED : first job launched
  STARTED --> COMPLETED : all stages pass
  STARTED --> FAILED : any stage fails
  STARTED --> STOPPING : stop() called

  STOPPING --> STOPPED : Batch settles

  FAILED --> STARTING : resume()
  STOPPED --> STARTING : resume()

  COMPLETED --> [*]
  FAILED --> [*]
  STOPPED --> [*]
```

`NOT_RUN` is a **projection**, not a persisted status. Future stages that never launched because an earlier stage failed are shown as `NOT_RUN` in the read model but have no `iris_pipeline_run_execution` row.

---

## Watermark Mechanism

Jobs that declare a watermark field perform **incremental extraction** — only rows newer than the last extracted value are fetched.

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Engine
  participant WR as iris_watermark_record
  participant Src as Source DB
  participant Dst as Destination DB

  Engine->>WR: load last watermark value (or null → full extract)
  Engine->>Src: SELECT ... WHERE updated_at > {watermark}
  Src-->>Engine: result set
  Engine->>Dst: write rows (INSERT / UPSERT)
  Engine->>WR: update watermark to max(updated_at) in result
```

Watermark records are keyed by `(workspace, pipeline, job, watermark_field)`. This means different jobs in the same pipeline maintain independent watermarks.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `watermark_column` | Column name in the source table |
| `watermark_type` | `DATETIME` or `BIGINT` |
| Last value | Persisted in `iris_watermark_record` after each successful run |

A run that fails **does not advance the watermark** — the committed value from the last successful run is used on the next attempt.

---

## SSE Real-time Events

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant FE as Frontend (RunDetailPage)
  participant SSE as SSE Endpoint
  participant Listener as PipelineRunLifecycleService
  participant Batch as Spring Batch

  FE->>SSE: GET /api/v1/events/runs/:runId
  Note over FE,SSE: SSE connection held open

  Batch->>Listener: job_started
  Listener->>SSE: emit "job_started" event
  SSE-->>FE: data: { type: "job_started", jobName: "..." }
  FE->>FE: refetch GET /api/v1/sync-pipeline/:runId

  Batch->>Listener: job_finished (COMPLETED)
  Listener->>SSE: emit "job_finished" event
  SSE-->>FE: data: { type: "job_finished", jobName: "..." }
  FE->>FE: refetch run detail

  Batch->>Listener: run_completed
  Listener->>SSE: emit "run_completed" event
  SSE-->>FE: data: { type: "run_completed" }
  FE->>FE: refetch + update action buttons
```

Two SSE channels are available:

| Endpoint | Scope | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/events/runs` | Workspace-wide (all runs) | OverviewPage |
| `/api/v1/events/runs/:runId` | Single run | RunDetailPage |

The frontend uses SSE events as **cache invalidation signals** — each event triggers a full re-fetch of the relevant REST endpoint. There is no client-side state machine.

---

## API Surface

All endpoints are under `/api/v1/`. Workspace is resolved from `X-Iris-Workspace-Key` (default: `default`).

### Config endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/sync-config` | List all pipelines |
| `GET` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Get pipeline config with stage-grouped jobs |
| `POST` | `/sync-config` | Create pipeline |
| `PUT` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Replace pipeline config |
| `PATCH` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Partial update |
| `DELETE` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Delete pipeline (blocked if run history exists) |
| `POST` | `/sync-config/import` | Create from YAML/JSON file |
| `PUT` | `/sync-config/{id}/import` | Replace from YAML/JSON file |

### Folder endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/pipeline-tree` | Full folder tree with pipeline summaries |
| `POST` | `/pipeline-folders` | Create folder |
| `PUT` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}` | Rename or move folder |
| `GET` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}/delete-preview` | Preview delete impact |
| `DELETE` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}?recursive=` | Delete folder |

### Runtime endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline` | Execute pipeline |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/resume` | Resume failed/stopped run |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/rerun` | Rerun from snapshot |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/stop` | Cooperative stop |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}` | Full run detail (latest + attempts) |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline?pipelineId=&limit=&beforeRunId=` | Cursor-paginated run history |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline/recent?limit=&beforeRunId=` | Recent runs (workspace) |
| `DELETE` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}` | Delete terminal run |

### Observability endpoints

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `/actuator/health` | Spring Boot health check |
| `/actuator/metrics` | Micrometer metric names |
| `/actuator/prometheus` | Prometheus scrape endpoint |
| `/api/v1/overview/summary` | Dashboard aggregate summary |
| `/api/v1/events/runs` | SSE (workspace-scoped) |
| `/api/v1/events/runs/:runId` | SSE (run-scoped) |

| Directory | Contents |
|---|---|

| `types/irispipe.ts` | Full domain type definitions |
